title: Regulation (EC) No 767/2009
supports: Separates feed materials, compound feeds, complete feeds, and complementary feeds.
limitations: Does not classify every legacy AOM product label.

title: Regulation (EC) No 1831/2003
supports: Defines technological, sensory, nutritional, zootechnical, coccidiostat, and histomonostat additive categories.
limitations: Authorization remains substance, preparation, use, species, and date specific.

title: Commission Regulation (EU) No 68/2013
supports: Supports mineral feed materials, glycerine, former foodstuffs, and processing definitions.
limitations: Catalogue inclusion does not prove identity for ambiguous brands or waste streams.

title: Directive 2008/98/EC on waste
supports: Distinguishes qualifying by-products from waste and defines waste around discard status.
limitations: Legal status is jurisdictional and fact-specific; a source label alone cannot establish compliance.

title: Regulation (EC) No 1069/2009
supports: Defines animal by-products and derived products separately from generic waste and material identity.
limitations: Does not cover plant offal terminology or authorize a material for feed.

title: AGROVOC feed additives
supports: Separates feed-additive use from ordinary feed consumption.
limitations: Broad vocabulary scope does not replace regulatory authorization.

title: AGROVOC supplements
supports: Defines supplement by use with another feed, supporting role/formulation treatment rather than material identity.
limitations: Does not classify every product called supplement.

title: AGROVOC organic acids
supports: Places organic acids on a chemical identity axis.
limitations: Intended additive function requires separate evidence.

title: FoodOn food facets
supports: Supports separation of material, anatomy, chemical, quality, and process axes.
limitations: FoodOn scope is food-system wide and requires AOM-specific adaptation.

title: FoodOn transformation processes
supports: Supports process objective and component-separation modelling.
limitations: Does not prove a process was applied to a specific AOM material.

title: FoodOn relations
supports: Supports output/provenance relations distinct from processing applied to a feed.
limitations: AOM does not yet publish upstream brewing provenance assertions.

title: Megalac product evidence
supports: Supports calcium-salt rumen-protected fat product identity.
limitations: Manufacturer evidence applies to named product, not every protected-fat term.

title: EFSA Elancoban assessment
limitations: Authorization conditions remain dated and jurisdiction specific.

title: Whole Grains Council definition
supports: Supports bran, germ, and endosperm retention despite grinding.
limitations: Industry definition is used for component-retention semantics, not regulatory feed claims.

title: OWL 2 structural specification
supports: Supports explicit negative assertions and prevents treating missing process assertions as negative facts.
limitations: Positive retained-component statements still require source evidence.
